description:
Pocket Piano puts two full octaves under your fingers, stacked in two comfortable rows that fit the screen perfectly. Play chords, slide across the keys for a glissando, and shift octaves to reach from deep bass to sparkling highs.

Choose from four hand-tuned instruments — a warm Grand, a bell-like Electric piano, a classic drawbar Organ and a glowing Synth pad — all generated live on your device with zero samples to download.

Got a tune in your head? Hit record, play it, and listen back instantly. Your last melody is saved for next time. On a laptop you can even play from the keyboard: A S D F G H J for white keys, W E T Y U for black keys, Z and X to change octave.
whatsNew: Sustain pedal, a brand new Synth pad instrument, and recordings now survive closing the app.
